name: Random Forest
description: Ensemble of decision trees; strong tabular-data baseline.

name: XGBoost
description: Gradient-boosted trees; widely used for structured/tabular prediction.

name: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
description: Standard architecture for image and grid-structured data.

name: Transformer
description: Attention-based architecture underlying most modern NLP/vision models.

name: BERT
description: Pretrained bidirectional transformer for NLP understanding tasks.

name: Graph Neural Network (GNN)
description: Architecture family for learning over graph-structured data.

name: Reinforcement Learning (PPO)
description: Proximal Policy Optimization; common RL algorithm for control/robotics.

name: Support Vector Machine (SVM)
description: Classical margin-based classifier, strong on small/medium datasets.

name: Isolation Forest
description: Tree-based anomaly/outlier detection algorithm, common in cybersecurity/finance.

name: Federated Averaging (FedAvg)
description: Core federated-learning algorithm for privacy-preserving distributed training.

name: U-Net
description: Encoder-decoder CNN architecture widely used for medical image segmentation.

name: YOLO (You Only Look Once)
description: Real-time object detection architecture, common in robotics/vision.

name: ARIMA
description: Classical statistical time-series forecasting model, common in finance.

name: Deep Q-Network (DQN)
description: Value-based deep RL algorithm for discrete-action control problems.
